title: Settings: localize the engine-update status messages
description: The engine-update card's four status lines (newer engine available, none found, already latest, downloaded) were hard-coded English. They now go through L/LF with translations in all six shipped languages. Adds Localization.string(_:in:) plus a test suite that checks every translation keeps its key's format placeholders (a mismatch is a String(format:) crash) and that these messages substitute the engine name in every language.
commit_message: Settings: localize the engine-update status messages; test translation placeholders
